about_the_game:
Add a quest offering advantageous consumable items and 10,000 glee.

Adds quests offering DLC items in Exploration Mode to the Guild Quests at Shooting Starlight.

Quests added by clearing Chapter 2, Blue Garden Arc #1.

Quest

You got a Starter Pack.

Clear Reward

･Energy Drink ×5

･Ether Candy ×5

･10000 Glee

- Please be mindful of the number of items in your inventory. If items obtainable upon clearing a quest would go over your inventory limit, you won't be able to obtain them.

- The same quest is included with the Deluxe Edition. Please be aware that you can't undertake this quest twice.
